description: Replaces Jellyfin's built-in SQLite database with PostgreSQL. Intended for large libraries and multi-instance deployments where SQLite's single-writer model is the bottleneck. Requires a fresh database; there is no in-place migration from an existing SQLite library.
name: PostgreSQL

versions.changelog: Write serialization, ORDER BY null placement, provider housekeeping
Adds prebuilt docker image with the plugin. Backup path construction hardened. Built against Jellyfin 12 RC7.

Initial release. Targets Jellyfin v12 (RC6).

> [!WARNING]
> Highly experimental. Only built and tested against Jellyfin v12 RC6. Don't use this with data you can't afford to lose.
